prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1364; do not mention it.)
text: I was stopped at a red light on Broadway Street in Pearland, Texas, waiting to make a turn, when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The vehicle that hit me had been following closely and did not appear to slow down in time. My car was pushed forward into the intersection, and I braced myself against the steering wheel with my left hand. Afterward, my wrist was swollen and painful, and I could not grip anything properly. I was taken to a nearby clinic, where an X-ray showed a fracture, and I was given a splint and told to follow up with an orthopedic specialist. I have kept all medical receipts and the photos I took of both vehicles at the scene. I am providing this account so the claim can be reviewed.
